content.short: Onramp.money is a payments layer for buying, selling, and swapping crypto with local rails across markets.
content.description: Onramp.money positions itself as payment infrastructure for Web3 onboarding, giving users and partner apps a way to move between local currency and crypto without relying on a traditional exchange flow. Its official product pages highlight onramp, offramp, swaps, gift card spending, compliance handling, and support for many countries, currencies, and tokens through widget, API, and SDK integrations. For TON users, the service matters as a practical access point for funding wallets or exiting back to fiat through local payment methods rather than as a protocol built directly on TON.
content.meta: Onramp.money offers fiat to crypto payments, offramps, swaps, and partner integrations that help users access assets across chains.
